---
# ── PROJECT TEMPLATE — copy into src/content/projects/<slug>.mdx ──
# (filename becomes the URL: my-build.mdx → /projects/my-build/)
# ── PROJECT TEMPLATE ──────────────────────────────────────────
# Copy this file to a new name (the filename becomes the URL slug:
# my-build.mdx → /projects/my-build/). Files starting with _ are
# ignored by the site, so this template never publishes.
#
# REQUIRED:
title: Project name
description: One sentence shown on cards and meta tags.
categories: [keyboard] # one or more of: software | keyboard | cad | pcb | 3d-printing
date: 2026-01-01 # roughly when built/shipped; drives sort order
draft: true # visible in local dev, excluded from the live site.

# OPTIONAL:
featured: false # true = appears in the homepage Featured section (top 3 by date)
status: active # active | completed | shelved
# links:
#   repo: https://github.com/bcunderscore/example
#   live: https://example.com
# cover: ../../assets/my-build/main.jpeg      # hero + card + share image
# gallery: # photo grid on the detail page
#   - ../../assets/my-build/photo-2.jpeg
#   - ../../assets/my-build/photo-3.jpeg
# specs: # renders the spec-sheet panel; any key/value pairs
#   switches: Boba U4T
#   keycaps: MT3 Susuwatari
#   plate: brass
#   firmware: Vial
---

The project story in markdown. Everything above adapts automatically:
no specs = no spec sheet, no gallery = no photo grid, no links = no buttons.
